text.formatted: This helm has 3 charges. While wearing it, you can use an action and expend 1 charge to cast the Teleport spell from it. The helm regains 1d3 expended charges daily at dawn.
text.plain: This helm has 3 charges. While wearing it, you can use an action and expend 1 charge to cast the Teleport spell from it. The helm regains 1d3 expended charges daily at dawn.
